text: Ñalnde Darngal, woŋkii kala taway golle makki kin immorde e moƴƴere; ɗum no ɓannaa ɗuytaaka, e kon ko ki golli immorde e bone; hiki yoloo sinno wonayno hakkunde makki e majje dummunne woɗɗuɗo. Hol no heɓirta on yela?! Alla No Reŋtina on e Hoore Mun, wata faggito bakkaatu ko O Tikkirana on. Alla ko Hilnotooɗo jeyaaɓe ɓen; ko ɗum waɗi si Mo Reŋtina ɓe Hulɓina ɓe.
